alex_dev: CI is failing on repo=infra/ssl-proxy — vuln scanner flagged a CVE in libssl binding (CVE-2024-XXXX). I think it's a false positive because we vendor a shim that doesn't expose the vulnerable API. Can we get a short-lived waiver so builds don't block?

sara_sec: can you drop the scanner output + the exact file path? we need evidence it's not actually used at runtime. also list affected environments (staging/prod).

chris_sre: pasted output from the job:
```
[scan] PKG: openssl 1.1.1k
[scan] FILE: /app/vendor/legacy/openssl_shim.so
[scan] CVE: CVE-2024-XXXX (HIGH) - reported in libssl poll API
```
We only ship this shim in the dev container image for legacy tests, not in production images. Prod uses boringssl build (verified).

alex_dev: confirmation: image manifest for prod-service:sha=ab12c shows no /app/vendor folder. grep in runtime container: `ls /lib | grep ssl || true` returns `libcrypto.so.1.1` (from boringssl bundle) — I can paste the manifest if that helps.

sara_sec: ok helpful. three asks before an exception: 1) prove non-exposure in prod (image manifest + CI matrix), 2) compensating controls while waived, 3) remediation plan + ETA.

chris_sre: proposed compensating controls: a) block prod deploys for infra/ssl-proxy until patched, b) add egress denylist for the test image in prod network policies, c) enable audit log retention for 90 days for affected services, d) enforce KMS key rotation for signing keys used by the test harness (rotate within 48h). I can put network policy + deploy-block in a PR today.

julie_prodsec: also require RBAC scope reduction for the test job: move it to a dedicated service-account with no access to prod DBs. we need a proof-of-control step in PR.

alex_dev: timeline: I can remove the vendored shim from CI images in 72 hours and open a PR to bump openssl to patched version upstream within 7 days. If we need more time, we can migrate tests to the boringssl image.

security-bot: compliance:tag=temporary-waiver requested_by=alex_dev scope=repo:infra/ssl-proxy duration=72h controls=[deploy-block,netpol,audit-retention] ticket=SEC-4982

sara_sec: decision: approve short-lived waiver for 72 hours scoped to the CI job `legacy-integration` in infra/ssl-proxy only. Conditions: - must merge PR that adds deploy-block and network policy before waiver is active - post the remediation PR (dependency bump or shim removal) linked to SEC-4982 with ETA <= 7 days - KMS rotation scheduled and logged - add audit logging retention to 90d. I'll sign off when PRs are linked.

chris_sre: created PR #281: "block prod deploys + add netpol for legacy test image" — includes a `kubectl` snippet and an audit policy change. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/ssl-proxy/pull/281

alex_dev: created remediation PR #282 to remove shim from CI image (WIP) and will open dependency bump PR for openssl upstream once CI passes.

julie_prodsec: noted — adding a short Slack approval record for compliance team. please tag me when KMS rotation is done.

alex_dev: tagging final: @sara_sec @julie_prodsec — waiver requested, PRs created. marking this thread for close after Sara approves. :thumbsup:
